layer.title: Talking Therapies Mean Wait
layer.description: Mean wait in days for people accessing NHS Talking Therapies services. Useful as a structural access and service-pressure signal.

interpretation.summary: Shows the average wait in days for people accessing NHS Talking Therapies services in each Sub ICB area.
interpretation.higherValuesMean: Higher values mean longer average waits to access Talking Therapies services.
interpretation.rankingTitle: Areas with the longest mean Talking Therapies waits

source.datasetTitle: NHS Talking Therapies monthly activity and performance
source.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 unless stated otherwise by the publisher
source.caveat: This is a mean wait measure at Sub ICB geography, not a person-level guarantee. Local suppression and monthly operational variation can affect interpretation.
